description: This file is a C# unit test class for testing 'Grammar by example' functionality related to barcodes within the MigraDoc project. It defines a test class 'DdlGBE_Barcode' that inherits from a base test class and utilizes the Xunit testing framework. The class contains test initialization and a parameterized test method that can be adapted for different rendering targets (CORE, GDI, WPF).
